scope: Separate bounded service-response admission from the ordinary publish command queue. Request::respond alone uses min(Config.capacity,64) response slots; worker interleaves one response before each ordinary command. No public API, wire format, deadline, or existing assertion change.

limits: Response-only bursts can drain roughly one per worker idle poll, with up to 2ms wait per poll; no unconditional latency guarantee.
Downstream replies queue capacity and ROUTER send can still fail independently; success is established for the exact flood and Sim cases.

Private Sim path redirection is a reviewer control, not public consumer adoption. Transport metadata binding, final exact gate, normal protected hook, public push and hosted qualification remain required before Root adopts a public pin.
